title: Anime Action RPG Elemental Duel Trailer
summary: Action RPG duel trailer prompt for water versus thunder techniques, with telegraphs, counterplay windows, VFX readability, and no-gore spectacle.
prompt:
Create a 15 second combat trailer for an anime action RPG boss duel: Water Form versus Thunder Form. The trailer must read like gameplay capture with cinematic polish, not a film adaptation.

0-5s: Player swordsman in green-black haori lowers stance in a moonlit forest arena. Blue water-dragon VFX coils around the blade. Show the boss lock-on reticle, stamina bar, and a clear wind-up telegraph.

5-10s: Rival thunder swordsman dashes in with golden lightning. Use fast cuts only after the telegraph is readable. Show dodge timing, parry flash, short hitstop, and elemental clash without gore.

10-13s: The player executes a perfect counter. Water arc splits the lightning path, camera shakes briefly, and damage numbers appear as optional trailer UI.

13-15s: Both fighters reset at opposite sides of the arena, boss phase marker shifts to PHASE 2, and the soundtrack rises. End on readable combat spacing and strong replay value.
